title: 85 lbs (40 kg) armwrestling style preacher curls for 7
summary: Do the negative unassisted and let the bicep stretch until the forearm is parallel with the floor then assist the positive phase with the other hand. While this is a safe way to apply weighted stretch to the biceps it should be reserved to lifters with good arm development, this is not for novices.
